text:
Ava (People Ops): Short heads-up: updated OKR + self-review templates are live. Quick link: https://redwoodinference.docs/okrs/template-2026
Ravi (Eng Manager): Nice. Is there a one-line checklist I can share in team sync?
Ava (People Ops): Yep TL;DR: 1) 3 priority team OKRs, 2) owner + metric per OKR, 3) label Committed/Stretch, 4) each person adds 1 dev goal and 1-page self-review, 5) managers add a 1-2 paragraph note + suggested rating.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: self-reviews open 2026-04-01 09:00 UTC.
Sam (IC): Can someone paste a tiny self-review starter? I always overwrite the doc.
Ava (People Ops): Micro-template you can copy:
````
What I shipped (2-4 bullets)
Impact (metrics/links)
Key learnings / blockers
Focus next quarter + 1 dev skill goal
Support needed from manager
````
Clara (Manager): For infra teams with long work, any sample milestone breakdown?
Ava (People Ops): Example:
OKR: Improve hosted inference reliability
- Q1 milestone: add KV cache + tests (signal: canary p99)
- Q2 milestone: rollout to region B (signal: errors <= X)
Use proxy metrics if direct ones are hard.
Ravi (Eng Manager): How strict are Committed vs Stretch? People might pad.
Ava (People Ops): Committed = what you expect to deliver this quarter. Stretch = upside. Managers should calibrate in 1:1s; call out if something was moved between labels.
Sam (IC): Do managers need to fill a rubric?
Ava (People Ops): Use the rating dropdown (Exceeds/Meets/Needs Improvement) + a short manager note. Include the date of your calibration 1:1.
people-ops-bot: Calendar event created: "Self-review deadline" 2026-04-10 09:00 UTC.
Clara (Manager): Thanks — I'll run a 10-min OKR primer in my team sync and paste the one-pager.
